standing: selected planning interpretation; not an executed formal assurance
formal_expression: P=(id,revision,g,i,k,u,C,delta,H,E,O,R,Q,V); D={reuse,specialize,propose,open}; WellFormed(P) iff ExactIdentity(id,revision) and BoundedGoalContextUse(g,k,u) and TraceableIntent(g,i) and FiniteNonempty(C) and (delta in Functions(C,D)) and (dom(H)=C) and (forall c in C: PayloadMatches(H(c),delta(c))) and (forall r in References(P): (ResolvedWithStanding(r) or DeclaredGap(r,Q))) and ValidationScopeDeclared(V). WellFormed(P) does not entail ConsumerReady(P,u), admission of a candidate Definition, or permission to execute.

tuple_fields.id,revision: Stable exact pack identity and revision binding.
tuple_fields.g: Bounded goal, goal-owner route or explicit unresolved owner gap.
tuple_fields.i: Attributable originating intent with explicit revision lineage.
tuple_fields.u: Named consumer plus exact intended use.
tuple_fields.C: Finite nonempty distinct required concept identities.
tuple_fields.delta: Total function into the four closed disposition tags.
tuple_fields.H: Per-concept payload function with exactly matching variant.
tuple_fields.O: Owner routes and exact authority evidence when required, never implicit appointments.
tuple_fields.R: Explicit scoped relationship records; no automatic global relation.
tuple_fields.V: Exact validation subject/input/profile/outcome scope and evidence ceiling.

predicates.ExactIdentity: Required ID/revision present and bound to immutable material; a digest is integrity evidence, not ownership authentication.
predicates.BoundedGoalContextUse: Explicit goal, context, exclusions, consumer and intended use; unsupported or missing constraints are declared gaps and may block named readiness.
predicates.TraceableIntent: Input intent and explicit changes are preserved with attributable source and lineage.
predicates.FiniteNonempty: At least one distinct concept; larger than selected limit requires explicit batch continuation.
predicates.Functions(C,D): Reject missing, duplicate, undeclared concept rows and invalid tags before building a total single-valued map.
predicates.PayloadMatches: The exact disposition variant and its required fields match the tag; candidate text can remain candidate and supplemental missing fields block complete Definition preparation.
predicates.References: Every selected governing/source/consumer/owner/relationship reference relevant to the declared use.
predicates.ResolvedWithStanding: Exact resolver output with scope, integrity/currentness/admission posture as applicable; resolution is not permission.
predicates.DeclaredGap: Reference or requirement explicitly named with affected use, reason, owner route and continuation; no invented resolution.
predicates.ValidationScopeDeclared: Profile and selected subject/input identity, criteria, outcome scope and evidence/claim ceiling present independently of reference resolution.
predicates.ConsumerReady: Separate selected-use gate requiring its blocking obligations to be satisfied; it is neither promotion nor execution permission.

required_review_cases: Resolved references and no validation scope fail WellFormed.
Unresolved reference without a declared gap fails WellFormed.
Duplicate current concept rows fail even if a dictionary overwrite would create one key.
A well-formed pack with an open blocking criterion may be reviewable but not ready for that consumer action.
A Pack can exist before Review and can reference Definitions without creating new meanings.
Distinct text can express the same meaning; lexical difference does not close a non-collapse obligation.
forbidden_inference: Any of these alone does not establish unrestricted/global consistency, human identity authentication, owner admission or agent permission.
